stages.doc: the criterion for a pixel's depth: the median of the valid depths in a window around it (stage event depth_window)

stages.name: projection
stages.doc: how many points are in front of the camera and inside the image
stages.line: {result.world_points[?in_frame=true]|count} of {result.world_points|count} inside the image, {result.world_points[?in_front=false]|count} behind the camera

stages.name: depth residual
stages.doc: the point's camera-frame depth minus the depth image's at its pixel: negative in front of the visible surface, positive behind it
stages.line: min {result.world_points[].depth_residual_m|min|mm1}, max {result.world_points[].depth_residual_m|max|mm1} (negative: the point is in front of the visible surface, positive: behind it)
